text:
8788 právartatē 'happens' VS., 'is set in motion' ChUp. 2. Pp. právr̥tta- VS. 3. právartayati 'sets in
motion' RV. [√ vr̥t ] 1. Pa. pavattati 'moves, goes on, exists', Pk. pavattaï , paütt° , pavaṭṭ° , payaṭṭ° intr. 'begins'; Si. pavatinavā 'to
last, exist, be' ( i is secondary H. Hendriksen BSOAS
xiii 154), caus. pavatvanavā . 2. Pa. pavatta - 'happening'; Pk. pavitta -, païtta -, paütta -, pavaṭṭa -, payaṭṭa - 'begun'; Ku. paito m.
'commencement of a journey', paiṭaṇo 'to make preparations
to go, start'; N. paiṭinu 'to begin to be used',
caus. paiṭyāunu . 3. Pa. pavattēti 'causes to go on'; Aś. pavatayevū opt., pavatitaviyā ger. 'to perform'; Pk. pavattēi tr. 'begins'.
html:
